turns.message: I run a small business and need a car for about one year, around 20,000 km. I cannot decide between leasing and buying. What should I compare?
turns.reply: When comparing leasing versus buying for your business, it helps to look at total cost, upfront and final payments, mileage limits, exit terms, and ownership over that one-year period. Insurance and maintenance are included only if stated in the specific offer and contract. Would you like to check what vehicle group fits your work?

turns.message: A small SUV is my preference. I really need only twelve months and do not want three years. What happens if I need to leave early or drive more than 20,000 km?
turns.reply: For a twelve-month lease with a small SUV, early exit terms and any excess kilometre charges depend on the specific offer and contract. Would you like to check what SUV options are available for your business?
